proposal.summary: Authenticated Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF) in Label Studio <= 1.5.0 allows an authenticated user (including self-registered users) to fetch arbitrary files via the Data Import module, enabling access to local files (file://).
proposal.cwe_quote:
Server Side Request Forgery (SSRF) in the Data Import module in Heartex - Label Studio Community Edition
versions 1.5.0 and earlier allows an authenticated user to access arbitrary files on the system.

proposal.recommended_next_step: Verify the vulnerability on an internal test instance and collect request/response evidence (import request, file-upload lookup, retrieved file contents). Determine whether registration is enabled and whether admin privileges are required; if confirmed, redact sensitive data and notify the vendor with reproduction steps and suggested mitigation (validate/whitelist import URL schemes and disable file:// access).

evidence_quotes.claim: Self-registration enables remote attacker to get an account
evidence_quotes.quote:
Furthermore, self-registration is enabled by default in these versions of Label Studio enabling a remote
attacker to create a new account and then exploit the SSRF.
